# nomatron_approval_policy (Resource)

Nomatron application approval policy resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nomatron_approval_policy" "example" {
  org_name = "platform"
  app_slug = "payments"

  default_rule = {
    required_approvals = 1
    users              = ["alice"]
    groups             = []
  }

  environment_rules = [
    {
      environment_id     = "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa"
      required_approvals = 2
      users              = ["alice", "bob"]
      groups             = ["bbbbbbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"]
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_slug` (String) Application slug that owns the approval policy.
- `default_rule` (Attributes) Approval policy rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--default_rule))
- `org_name` (String) Organization name that owns the application.

### Optional

- `environment_rules` (Attributes List) Environment-specific approval policy overrides. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment_rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable composite identifier for the approval policy.
- `version` (Number) Approval policy version.

<a id="nestedatt--default_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `default_rule`

Required:

- `required_approvals` (Number) Number of approvals required by this rule.

Optional:

- `groups` (List of String) Group IDs that can approve.
- `users` (List of String) Usernames that can approve.


<a id="nestedatt--environment_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environment_rules`

Required:

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID this rule applies to.
- `required_approvals` (Number) Number of approvals required by this rule.

Optional:

- `groups` (List of String) Group IDs that can approve.
- `users` (List of String) Usernames that can approve.
